title: Random restriction expectation as an assignment sum
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\delta\in\mathbb R$, and let $g$ be any real-valued function of a free-coordinate subset of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$ and signs on its complement. The random restriction expectation of $g$ equals the sum over all coordinate assignments in which each coordinate is free, fixed to $+1$, or fixed to $-1$: each assignment contributes its value of $g$ multiplied by the product of coordinate weights, where a free coordinate has weight $\delta$ and either fixed sign has weight $(1-\delta)/2$.
hypotheses_covered: Function $g$ on a free-coordinate subset and signs on its complement
